description: This file defines an abstract class 'Smarty_Internal_CompileBase' which provides methods for handling attributes, tag stack operations, and error handling for Smarty template compilation plugins.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_CompileBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing core methods for Smarty internal compile plugins, including attribute validation and tag stack management.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Validates and processes attributes passed to a Smarty tag, ensuring required attributes are present and optional attributes are valid.

methods.name: openTag
methods.description: Pushes an opening tag onto the internal tag stack, optionally saving additional data.

methods.name: closeTag
methods.description: Pops an opening tag from the stack, verifies correct nesting, and returns the tag name or associated data.
